visual_name: Day in the life, part eighteen: a cover letter for a lip balm (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js post office with a drawn wall of PO boxes, box-built character, job boards / five listings / Find deals / a wax-sealed letter, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 37.3 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: five job boards and five bad listings (412 applicants, a free sample video, a cover letter for a lip balm, closed in 2023, pay to apply); then YourBrand's Find deals: campaigns open right now, press apply, YourBrand reviews it, new campaigns posted there first. He wrote the lip balm letter anyway. It was beautiful.
